plan.title: Issue tree: Lint node between Work and Review showing verification gate output
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The Lint node feature (verification artifact writer, 'lint' SessionNode builder wired into both tree payloads, contracts literal, TYPE_PRIORITY ordering, SessionPanel VerificationGatesPanel branch) was already merged to main on 2026-07-14 in commits b2be1d6256, da0c867c25, ea03c099d5, 3e58582787, e0225f6a35, 51cdb1d117 — the feature branch has zero delta vs origin/main. Three residual gaps remain: the ProjectTree rail renders the raw lowercase label 'lint' with the generic Code2 work icon and a generic purpose description (AgentStepRow.tsx has no 'lint' case in deriveSessionLabel, TYPE_ICON, or describeSessionPurpose); buildLintSessionNode has no unit tests; and no doc describes the Lint node or the verification artifact.
narratives.Proposal: Close only the residual delta with three small independent items: (1) add the 'lint' cases (label 'Lint', icon ListChecks, purpose text) to AgentStepRow.tsx plus a rail-density rendering test; (2) add unit tests for buildLintSessionNode at tests/unit/dashboard/command-deck-lint-node.test.ts covering null suppression, failed transcript content, running presence, no-artifact fallback, and transcript omission; (3) document the Lint node and .overdeck/verification-latest.json in docs/MISSION-CONTROL.md near the /api/session-trees description. The PRD draft (.pan/drafts/PAN-2665.md) carries exact file/line references and before/after guidance.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Re-implementing or modifying the merged verification artifact writer (src/lib/cloister/verification-artifact.ts), lint node builder (command-deck-lint-node.ts), contracts SessionNodeType, TYPE_PRIORITY ordering, or the SessionPanel lint branch
- Changing gate semantics, gate order, verification dispatch, or the verification runner
- Cockpit tile-color treatment for the lint node (default styling is acceptable)
- OKF knowledge-bundle updates (owned by the knowledge role)
- New endpoints, stores, or polling loops

autoDecisions.summary: Scoped the plan to the residual delta (label/icon/purpose, builder unit tests, docs) instead of the full issue body.
autoDecisions.rationale: Code-level audit showed all three issue bullets except 'labels, icons' already merged to main on 2026-07-14 with zero branch delta; re-planning merged work would dispatch a work agent to duplicate it.

autoDecisions.summary: Chose ListChecks (lucide-react) as the lint row icon.
autoDecisions.rationale: A checklist icon reads as the quality-gate table; it is unused by any other node type or reviewer role in AgentStepRow.tsx, keeping the row visually distinct from Work's Code2.
tests/unit/dashboard/ is the established home for server route unit tests (e.g. git-activity-route.test.ts); src/dashboard/server/routes has no __tests__ directory.

autoDecisions.summary: Placed docs in docs/MISSION-CONTROL.md near the /api/session-trees description.
autoDecisions.rationale: That doc already describes the session-tree payload the Lint node rides in; no other doc enumerates tree node sources.

expected_outputs: command-deck-lint-node.test.ts passes with all five behavior cases green

narrative.Action: Create tests/unit/dashboard/command-deck-lint-node.test.ts exercising buildLintSessionNode from src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck-lint-node.ts. Write a real .overdeck/verification-latest.json into a fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()) workspace per case — do not mock fs (readVerificationArtifact has its own JSON-parse fallback). No fake timers needed (no delays/retries). Cases: (1) returns null with no artifact and centralStatus null or verificationStatus 'skipped'; (2) failed artifact yields status 'failed', presence 'ended', transcript containing the failing gate's '✗ <gate>' line and '--- <gate> output ---' block; (3) running artifact (outcome 'running', currentGate set) yields status 'running', presence 'active', transcript containing '▶ <gate> running…'; (4) no artifact with verificationStatus 'passed' yields status 'completed' and the 'No gate details recorded' fallback text; (5) includeTranscripts false yields a node without a transcript key.

items.title: Given no artifact and centralStatus null or verificationStatus 'skipped', buildLintSessionNode returns null
Given a failed artifact with gate output, the node has status 'failed', presence 'ended', and its transcript contains the failing gate line and its '--- <gate> output ---' block
Given a running artifact with currentGate set, the node has status 'running', presence 'active', and its transcript contains the '▶ <gate> running…' line

Given no artifact but verificationStatus 'passed', the node has status 'completed' and its transcript contains the 'No gate details recorded' fallback; given includeTranscripts false, the returned node omits the transcript key
Document the Lint node and verification artifact in MISSION-CONTROL.md

expected_outputs: grep prints the new 'Lint node (PAN-2665)' subsection heading with its line number
